entry.title: Po Nagar

buildingCutout.basis: Replace only the four Po Nagar shrine shells and the mandapa rectangle with a two-centimeter numeric tolerance to prevent zero-area native edge slivers. Preserve all independent museum and independent buildings, native courtyard ground and water.

terrainReference.basis: Original standard6m Mapzen hill/city ground and water retained. Each tower and occupied mandapa platform has its own local level top with grade-buried bottom; short tower approaches and narrow connecting stair/cheeks follow the sampled coarse native grade. Open upper courts stay native ground. No broad hill/precinct slab, flattening or ground/water cutout. Coarse DEM does not resolve actual paved terraces, stair thresholds or cliff/retaining faces. Its retained mandapa maximum sample is slightly above the main-tower floor, so the narrow approach follows coarse native grade rather than recreating the photographed steep descent. This level relationship remains a terrain-resolution limitation.
